spec_features.spec_quote: A failed turn aborts only that conversation (recorded as `rollout_error`)
spec_features.evidence: rollout.py:112-118 wraps backend.generate in try/except; on Exception it sets result.error=f'turn {turn+1}: {exc}' and `break`s the per-conversation turn loop (aborting only that conversation). Each rollout is an independent future (run_eval.py:90-99 ThreadPoolExecutor), so one failure does not kill others. run_eval.py:73 writes 'rollout_error': roll.error into each JSONL record. End-to-end: error caught, loop broken, value recorded.
spec_features.notes: This is a generic API/generation-failure handler (catches any Exception), not a distress-triggered stop; it does not protect the subject from distressing content. But the mechanism described in the claim is genuinely wired and enforced.
